- conv1: 3->16, 3x3 pad1 -> ReLU -> MaxPool

- Early conv layers (conv1) might have filters that respond to the patch (edges/corners, high frequency, or specific color).
- Since patch is always at same corner and small (3-5 px, 1 px in from corner), the network could learn a filter that activates strongly only when that corner pattern is present.
- Because of global average pooling + fc, a single conv3 channel that fires strongly at the patch location could be read out by fc to boost target class.
